messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency > SLO for /v1/chat/stream in prod-us-west-2
incident-bot: severity=page, metric=p99_latency_ms, value=6100, threshold=5000, ts=1718259999

priya_oncall: paging oncall here, looking into dashboards now.

emma_support: we've got 6 customer tickets, a couple enterprise tenants saw streaming timeouts and truncated outputs. Details on support queue.

priya_oncall: quick ask @emma_support — org list and examples pls

emma_support: impacted: org-orbit, org-borealis, 4 SMBs. Rep from org-orbit pasted a log: partial stream then connection closed.

ryan_ml: adding early hypothesis: yesterday's prompt template change (embed-tool-schemas-for-json) went live in a canary then full rollout. It expands tool schemas into the prompt for JSON-mode. Might balloon token counts.

sam_runtime: checking traces — tracer id f9c3d2 shows preproc: 4.9s, tokenizer: 1.6s, model-start: 0.2s. Tail looks dominated by preproc + tokenization.

priya_oncall: p95 vs p99 numbers?

priya_oncall: (pulling metrics) p95 ~700ms (baseline ~200ms), p99 ~6.1s (baseline ~430ms). request QPS steady. streaming stall rate spiked ~+3x.

devon_infra: I can roll back the templating deploy if we want immediate revert. We also have feature flags for JSON-mode inlining per-org.

ryan_ml: prefer targeted mitigations first: disable schema inlining for affected orgs via flag, and set a hard-size cap for inline payloads.

priya_oncall: agreed — take these steps: 1) flip flag for org-orbit/org-borealis, 2) apply size cap at edge (truncate inline schema to 2k chars), 3) restart preproc pods in us-west-2 to clear huge in-memory prompt buffers.

priya_oncall: executing 1) now: `PATCH /internal/flags {org: "org-orbit", flag: "json_schema_inline", enabled: false}` -> 200
priya_oncall: `PATCH /internal/flags {org: "org-borealis", flag: "json_schema_inline", enabled: false}` -> 200

incident-bot: note: feature flag updates deployed at 1718260102 by priya_oncall

devon_infra: rolling restart preproc deployment in us-west-2: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/preproc -n prod --selector=region=us-west-2`
devon_infra: restarting 4 pods, monitoring readiness

(2m later)

priya_oncall: metrics update: p95 ~250ms, p99 ~980ms. streaming drop rate back near baseline. partial responses reduced.

olivia_sre: good improvement. We should still add temporary capacity to preproc to be safe — +2 replicas in us-west-2.

devon_infra: scaled preproc +2 replicas, applied traffic-split to send 10% to v1-fast fallback variant.

ryan_ml: for longer term: patch the templating logic to summarize tool schemas (field names + types only) instead of full descriptors when in JSON-mode, and add a precondition to skip inlining when resulting prompt token delta > 1500.

alex_product: also need to improve rollout guardrails: require canary against prompt-size metric and a kill-switch in the control plane to disable new templating quickly.

priya_oncall: action items (owners):
- patch templating to summarization + cap (ryan_ml)
- add alert: prompt_preproc.token_count > 3000 (olivia_sre)
- add pre-merge QA step: prompt-sizing test for templating PRs (product)
- add deploy-time eviction for large prompt caches (devon_infra)
- customer impact summary & outbound comms (emma_support)

emma_support: notified org-orbit and org-borealis about temporary behavior change; they're okay with interim fix, want ETA for permanent patch. I'll prepare a follow-up note.

priya_oncall: handing off to @olivia_sre for monitoring at 1718260300 — all mitigations applied: flags off for impacted orgs, preproc restarted, extra capacity added, traffic-split in place. p99 trending down. I'll stay on-call if anything regresses.

olivia_sre: taking over. current snapshot: p95 240ms, p99 920ms and falling. streaming stall incidents decreased to baseline. I'll watch for 60m then consider page closure.

ryan_ml: attaching trace f9c3d2 and anonymized prompt sample showing ~11k chars after inlining (redacted). Will start the summarization patch, aiming for canary in 36h.

priya_oncall: incident timeline to channel: root cause = schema inlining in JSON-mode increased prompt tokens -> preproc/tokenizer tail -> streaming stalls and SLO breach. mitigation window ~10-18 minutes to apply flags + restarts.

incident-bot: Incident ticket created: https://incidents.redwood/1718259999

olivia_sre: planning closure if stable for 1h. For postmortem include customer list, peak p95/p99, duration above SLO, PR id and deploy times, and action owners.

emma_support: will draft customer-facing summary and send tomorrow morning PST.

priya_oncall: thanks all. note: add automated canary that computes prompt token delta for templating PRs. If delta > threshold, block rollout.

olivia_sre: closing page at 1718260800 (status: mitigated)
